module.title: Terminology, Value Sets and Dynamic Catalogs
module.business_purpose: A governed engine for every coded value the platform uses (diagnoses, statuses, units, roles...) based on international standards (SNOMED, LOINC, ICD, ATC, UCUM) plus local catalogs. It makes the system multilingual, interoperable and future-proof: new values are added without software changes.
